title.narrative: Support to People Affected by Severe Tropical Storm Trami through cash assistance

description.narrative: On 24 October, severe tropical storm (STS) Kristine (international name: Trami) made landfall in Northern Luzon and brought intense rains to different parts of the country. At its onset, nearly 7.7 million people have been affected by extensive flooding and landslides. To reach the most affected households in Bicol region, WFP is supporting the Government through the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) in providing cash assistance to people registered in 4Ps (Pantawid Pamilyang Pilipino Program) social assistance programme. WFP aims to provide i) one-month cash assistance top-up for 42,000 households followed by ii) two months support for 14,500 households with children under 5.Cash-based transfers will be used to cover the immedia`te food needs of people affected by the series of typhoons. The contribution from CERF will support WFP’s efforts to provide US$57 (PHP 3,350) per month to about 5,030 households (245,150 people) for two months. WFP will work with local governments to strengthen their capacity to produce sensitization materials and conduct sensitization sessions. WFP will orient 4Ps field staff to strengthen their capacities in engaging with beneficiaries on using the cash assistance for their overall health and wellbeing. In parallel, WFP will strengthen the DSWD’s existing grievance redress system to ensure feedback from communities are addressed in a timely manner.
